versions.changelog:
## 1.0.5

- Adds an OOMOL-connected ElevenLabs skill for operating through the `oo` CLI without handling raw API tokens.
- Supports text-to-speech generation, including character-level timestamp metadata.
- Provides sound effect generation from text prompts.
- Includes voice discovery, search, voice details, and voice settings lookup.
- Covers account, subscription, model, and generation history read actions.
- Marks write and destructive actions clearly for safer execution.

Source: `oomol-lab/skills@792ad44`

- Operate ElevenLabs through an OOMOL-connected account using the `oo` CLI.
- Inspect live action schemas and run validated JSON requests without handling raw API tokens.
- Generate text-to-speech audio, timestamped speech, and text-prompted sound effects.
- Manage voices, models, voice settings, user details, subscriptions, and generation history.
- Apply confirmation safeguards for state-changing and destructive actions.

Source: `oomol-lab/skills@75bac03`

- Provides OOMOL-backed access to ElevenLabs through the `oo` CLI, with credentials injected server-side.
- Covers voice discovery, voice details, voice settings, available models, user profile, and subscription lookups.
- Supports generated-item history workflows, including listing items, fetching metadata, downloading audio, and deleting history entries.
- Generates speech audio from text, including an option that returns character-level timestamp metadata.
- Generates sound effects from text prompts and uploads binary audio outputs to connector transit storage.
- Documents safety rules for read, write, and destructive ElevenLabs actions, plus first-time setup recovery steps.

Source: `oomol-lab/skills@4597539`

- Provides OOMOL-connected access to ElevenLabs through the `oo` CLI without exposing raw API tokens.
- Lists available voices, voice details, models, user profile, and subscription information.
- Retrieves generated history items, individual history metadata, and downloadable history audio.
- Generates text-to-speech audio and uploads binary results to connector transit storage.
- Documents schema-first action usage, safe read behavior, and setup recovery steps for auth, connection, billing, and CLI issues.

Source: `oomol-lab/skills@146ef20`

- Initial release of the `oo-elevenlabs` skill for operating ElevenLabs through an OOMOL-connected account using the `elevenlabs` connector.
- Generate text-to-speech audio and store binary results in connector transit storage.
- Browse ElevenLabs resources, including available voices, individual voice details, supported models, and text-to-speech capabilities.
- Inspect generated history items, retrieve individual history records, and download audio from history entries.
- Read authenticated account details, including user profile information and subscription status.
